description: This file defines the LeadsJjwg_MapsLogicHook class, which contains logic hook methods for updating geocode information related to lead records using the jjwg_Maps module in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: LeadsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: Defines logic hook functions to update geocoding info for leads and related meetings via the jjwg_Maps module.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Called before saving a lead; updates geocode information if logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Called after saving a lead; updates geocode info for related meetings if logic hooks are enabled.
